SD-LEO-FIX-VERIFY-MIGRATION-APPLY-001 — TESTING sub-agent, EXEC-TO-PLAN. Commit e132739638f, PR #8048, branch feat/SD-LEO-FIX-VERIFY-MIGRATION-APPLY-001.

FIX UNDER TEST: scripts/verify-migration-apply-state.mjs ~L808-817. The chairman-gated ceremony-pending ::warning:: annotation was on an unconditional console.log, appending a non-JSON line after the JSON closing brace in --json mode. Fix gates it behind the same asJson check the adjacent marker line already uses (9 LOC).

TS-1 INTEGRATION SUITE — PASS. 9/9 (5 pre-existing + 4 new) via: npx vitest run --project migration-gate tests/integration/migration-apply-state-ledger-wiring.test.js. Artifact step1-postfix.json.

TS-2 PURE-FUNCTION REGRESSION — PASS. 57/57 in tests/verify-migration-apply-state.test.js. Independently confirmed UNMODIFIED by this SD: git diff merge-base(HEAD,main)..HEAD on that path is empty; last touched by unrelated commit 2df50cfeede. Artifact step2-purefunc.json.

TS-4 MUTATION TEST — PERFORMED INDEPENDENTLY BY QA, NOT TAKEN ON TRUST FROM THE PR DESCRIPTION. Reverted the fix in place (if (asJson) console.error(warn); else console.log(warn);  ->  console.log(warn);), single occurrence. Result: 3 of the 4 NEW tests FAILED, with the real consumer-shaped error "SyntaxError: Unexpected non-whitespace character after JSON at position 559056". All 5 pre-existing tests correctly stayed green (mutation is properly scoped). The 4th new test ("the warning still lands on stdout in the ceremony-pending case") correctly PASSED under mutation because it exercises non---json mode, which the mutation does not affect — it is an over-correction guard, not a dead test. Fix then restored and verified BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-mutation original; suite returned to 9/9. Artifacts step3-mutated.json and step3-restored.json.

TS-5 DIRECT INVOCATION AGAINST REAL REPO STATE — PASS. node scripts/verify-migration-apply-state.mjs --json with streams separated, exit 0. Parsed using the EXACT consumer parse (first line whose column 0 is a brace, slice to END of string, JSON.parse) — a byte-faithful replica of chairman-apply-state.js:45-51, deliberately NOT a brace-matcher (a brace-matcher tolerates trailing content and would have passed even with the bug present). Parse OK; files[] length 1587; stdout contains no ::warning::; the warning is correctly on stderr. NON-VACUOUS: the ambient repo currently has 7 CEREMONY_PENDING files (fail-set 5), so this run genuinely exercised the bug path. Note stdout line 0 is the dotenvx banner, which is precisely why the consumer anchors on the first column-0 brace line.

TS-6 REAL CONSUMER END-TO-END — PASS (strongest evidence). Directly imported and awaited classifyMigrationApplyState() from scripts/modules/handoff/executors/lead-final-approval/chairman-apply-state.js. Returned error===null with files.length 1587 and histogram {APPLIED:1063, NO_DDL:373, NOT_APPLIED:89, PARTIAL:55, CEREMONY_PENDING:7}. Therefore the CHAIRMAN_APPLY_VERIFICATION gate at LEAD-FINAL-APPROVAL would NOT false-BLOCK. This is the actual gate consumer, not a replica.

TS-7 RELATED CONSUMER REGRESSION — PASS. 63/63 across the other 4 suites referencing verify-migration-apply-state / chairman-apply-state (chairman-apply-verification-widened, lead-final-chairman-apply-verification, migration-verification-access-control, migration-multi-root-scan). Artifact step5-related-regression.json.

TOTALS: 138/138 passed, 0 failed, across 6 suites. All counts machine-extracted from vitest --reporter=json outputs; no hand-typed numbers. The deliberate mutation run (9 tests / 3 intentional failures) is recorded separately and EXCLUDED from these totals by design.

HYGIENE: test fixture cleanup verified (no __test-fixture-* left in database/chairman-gated/); worktree verified clean (git status --porcelain -uno empty) after mutation testing.

CONFIDENCE 95/100 — held below 100 only because the fix is producer-side by design, so the 4 consumers remain individually unhardened against any future post-JSON stdout writer.
